tip: German writes the ones digit first: dreiundvierzig is drei-und-vierzig, literally three-and-forty for 43.
bewache, not bewacht, is Konjunktiv I: after besagt it marks reported speech, a claim you relay rather than assert.
Stellt is the ihr command: take the present-tense stellt and drop the pronoun ihr. No ending changes.
With a modal, hätte builds the past from two infinitives at the end: Hätte sie gehen können, not gekonnt.
